segments.text: हेलो हेलो हाँ एक से एक से हो

segments.en: Where from? Jabalpur. Okay, what do you do? Do you do a job?

segments.en: How is everyone in the family? Is everyone fine? Who all are in the family? Everyone is in the family.

segments.en: Okay, and did you have food, tea, breakfast? What did you make for food?

segments.text: मतलब और इस ऐप पे क्या क्या बातें हो सकती हैं पता नहीं यहाँ के बारे में
segments.en: Meaning, and what kind of things can be talked about on this app? I don't know about this place.

segments.en: And what else happens? By the way, how many days have you been here?

segments.en: By the way, why did you download it? Just to talk like that.

segments.en: Wherever you look, you will find it. By searching, even God can be found, so... [unclear]

segments.en: Here, I haven't come to become [unclear] yet, so...
